Stock market news | Bank Nifty crosses 64,000 for the first time as markets surge

Bank Nifty crossed the 64,000 mark for the first time on 20 November 2026. Both the Sensex and Nifty extended gains for a second straight session, surging over 2% across the week to mark their fourth consecutive weekly gain.
